* [spec] Fix the Windows test job (#30475) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)

* [sigh] Skip installing provisioning profiles when not on macOS (#30463) via John Szumski (@jszumski)
* [spaceship] prevent frozen error when logging response (#30460) via Connor Tumbleson (@iBotPeaches)
* Bump ossf/scorecard-action from 2.4.4 to 2.5.0 (#30449) via dependabot[bot] (@dependabot[bot])
* Bump ruby/setup-ruby from 1.327.0 to 1.329.0 (#30450) via dependabot[bot] (@dependabot[bot])
